Vikash	Kumar	Sr.	Manager	–	Security	Services

Email:	Vikash.vvs18@gmail.com	 Phone:	+91	8080322212

OVERVIEW

Senior	Manager	with	13+	years	of	experience	in	Information	Security,	Endpoint	Security,	and	GRC.	Proven	track	record	of	strengthening	 security	posture,	managing	risk,	and	driving	operational	efficiency.	Leverages	AI-driven	insights	and	automation	in	daily	operations	to	 enhance	decision-making,	streamline	processes,	and	deliver	measurable	business	outcomes.	Thrives	in	fast-paced	environments	with	a	 focus	on	continuous	improvement	and	innovation.

PROFESSIONAL	EXPERIENCE

Senior	Manager	in	Yash	Technologies,	Bangalore	–	(Dec	2025	–	Till	Date)	 Key	Deliverables:

Governed	end-to-end	cybersecurity	program	delivery,	aligning	with	organizational	objectives,	risk	management,	and	compliance

frameworks.	 Leveraged	AI-driven	tools	(Microsoft	Copilot)	to	optimize	security	operations,	enhance	productivity,	and	support	data-driven	 decision-making.	 Ensured	delivery	excellence	by	aligning	outcomes	with	KPIs,	SLAs,	and	Statements	of	Work	(SOWs).	 Led	transition	planning	and	execution	for	cybersecurity	initiatives,	ensuring	seamless	delivery	and	minimal	operational	disruption.	 Partnered	with	C-suite	and	senior	leadership	to	drive	alignment	on	security	strategy,	risk	posture,	and	business	goals.



• • • Translated	complex	cybersecurity,	risk,	and	compliance	concepts	into	clear,	business-focused	insights	for	stakeholders.	 • Directed	resource	management,	including	hiring,	workforce	planning,	and	upskilling,	leading	a	team	of	48	resources	to	deliver	high



performance.	 Performed	security	control	assessments,	gap	analysis,	and	risk	evaluations,	implementing	mitigation	strategies	aligned	with	ISO	 27001,	NIST,	and	industry	best	practices.

Managed	vendor	relationships,	including	contract	renewals,	cost	optimization,	and	capacity	planning,	improving	service	delivery efficiency.

Demonstrated	strong	communication	and	stakeholder	management	skills,	effectively	engaging	both	technical	and	non-technical audiences.	 Collaborated	with	global,	cross-functional	teams	to	drive	alignment,	innovation,	and	successful	program	execution.

• Utilized	advanced	MS	Office	(Excel,	PowerPoint,	Word)	and	reporting	tools	to	develop	executive	dashboards,	presentations,	and data-driven	insights.

Security	Delivery	Manager	in	Accenture,	Bangalore	–	(May	2024	–	Aug	2025)	 Key	Deliverables:

Defined	program	charters,	milestones,	and	execution	roadmaps	for	enterprise	Cybersecurity	Transformation	initiatives,	ensuring



alignment	with	Program	Governance	standards.	 Led	Operating	Committee	and	Steering	Committee	governance	forums,	driving	strategic	alignment,	risk	review,	and	Go/No-Go	 decision-making.

Managed	stakeholder	engagement,	cost	optimization,	and	budget	planning,	ensuring	effective	resource	allocation	and	financial







governance.	 Spearheaded	Tanium	platform	migration	from	On-Premises	to	vendor-managed	SaaS,	collaborating	with	Tech	Ops	to	ensure	 seamless	transition	and	minimal	downtime.	 Executed	Proof	of	Concepts	(POCs),	business	demonstrations,	and	end-to-end	implementation,	enabling	adoption	of	security	 solutions	and	technologies.	 Conducted	comprehensive	Cyber	Risk	Assessments	across	technical,	operational,	and	compliance	domains,	identifying	gaps,	 documenting	risks,	and	driving	remediation	actions.

Applied	expertise	in	Cybersecurity	Frameworks	and	Standards	including	NIST,	COBIT,	SOC	2,	and	regulatory	compliance requirements.

Developed	and	progressed	RFCs	(Request	for	Change)	for	integrations	across	ISD,	CMDB,	SIEM,	and	SOAR	platforms,	enhancing





security	operations	and	automation.	 	Strengthened	SaaS	Security	Governance	by	driving	SSPM	(SaaS	Security	Posture	Management)	adoption	and	managing	penetration	 testing	outcomes.	 Secured	enterprise	applications	through	SSO	(Single	Sign-On)	integration,	access	validation,	and	exception	management,	improving	 identity	and	access	controls.

Demonstrated	strong	problem-solving,	analytical	thinking,	and	attention	to	detail	to	ensure	high-quality	execution	and	continuous improvement.

Service	delivery	manager	in	Tata	Consultancy	Service,	Bangalore	–	(Sept	2022	–	May	2024)	 Key	Deliverables:

•

Led	a	cross-functional	Cybersecurity	Operations	team	of	44	associates	(including	5	Team	Leads)	across	global	onshore/offshore	 delivery	models,	ensuring	high	availability	and	operational	excellence.

Managed	enterprise	security	tools	including	CyberArk	(PAM),	Forescout	(Network	Access	Control),	Zscaler	(Zero	Trust),	Qualys (Vulnerability	Management),	and	Cisco	Email	Security,	strengthening	overall	security	posture.

Drove	Program	Governance	and	Service	Delivery	Excellence	by	leading	QBR	(Quarterly	Business	Review),	PMR,	MSR,	WSR,	daily



governance	cadences,	and	audit	readiness	initiatives.	 Strengthened	Governance,	Risk,	and	Compliance	(GRC)	by	aligning	with	regulatory	requirements,	implementing	NIST	framework	 controls,	conducting	CSS	reviews,	and	delivering	compliance	reporting.

Directed	Security	Incident	Management	(SIEM-driven	detection,	triage,	and	response)	for	high-priority	and	critical	threats,	acting as	an	escalation	point	and	ensuring	timely	remediation.

Demonstrated	strong	Stakeholder	Management,	influencing	outcomes	and	driving	alignment	with	Director	and	C-Suite	leadership



through	strategic	communication	and	negotiation.	 Led	Endpoint	Security	and	Antivirus	Operations	using	McAfee	ePO,	Microsoft	Defender	ATP	(MDE),	including	IOC	blocking,	 signature	updates,	threat	analysis,	and	compliance	reporting.

Managed	Identity	and	Access	Management	(IAM)	operations	through	Azure	Active	Directory	(AAD),	including	provisioning,	access governance,	and	SSO	integration.

Directed	security	tool	upgrades	and	platform	enhancements,	ensuring	scalability,	performance	optimization,	and	risk	reduction.	 • Supported	Windows	Server	Security	Operations,	delivering	advanced	reporting	and	analytics	using	ePO,	SCCM,	and	Microsoft	 Defender	for	Endpoint	(MDE).

Applied	ITIL	best	practices	through	ServiceNow	(Incident,	Problem,	Change	Management)	to	improve	service	delivery,	reduce downtime,	and	ensure	SLA	compliance.

Domain	Specialist	in	Philips	India	LTD.,	Bangalore	-	(Oct	2018	–	Aug	2022)	 Key	Deliverables:





Planned,	documented,	and	executed	system	upgrades	and	release	management	within	the	Digital	Workplace	environment,	 ensuring	smooth	production	deployment	and	minimal	business	disruption.	 Participated	in	Agile	daily	scrums	with	vendors	and	internal	teams,	tracking	progress,	resolving	blockers,	and	ensuring	SLA	 compliance.

Managed	Software	Lifecycle	Management	(SLM),	including	asset	tracking,	compliance	reporting,	and	vendor	coordination.	 • Delivered	end-user	and	Service	Desk	training,	and	led	global	communication	strategies	for	policy	updates,	system	enhancements,

and	incident	resolutions.	 Led	SaaS	application	onboarding	(e.g.,	Miro)	including	security	assessments,	risk	evaluation,	SSO	enablement,	ServiceNow	 integration,	and	user	provisioning.	 Strengthened	Governance,	Risk,	and	Compliance	(GRC)	by	applying	regulatory	frameworks	such	as	SOC	2,	HIPAA,	and	GDPR.



• Defined	security	requirements,	executed	system	upgrades,	and	developed	customized	technical	solutions	aligned	with	business	and compliance	objectives.

Built	dashboards	and	custom	reports	using	Trellix/McAfee	ePO	and	monitored/responded	to	Data	Loss	Prevention	(DLP)	events and	security	alerts.

Utilized	ServiceNow	(ITIL	framework)	for	Incident,	Problem,	and	Change	Management,	improving	service	efficiency	and governance.

Managed	1E	Software	Distribution	Platform,	enabling	efficient	and	scalable	global	software	deployment	and	patch	management.

Senior	Project	Engineer	in	Wipro	Technologies	–	(January	2013	–	October	2018)	 Key	Deliverables:	McAfee/Trellix	EPO

■ Deployed	and	monitored	endpoint	security	via	ePO,	ensuring	compliance	across	systems.	 ■ Generated	compliance	reports	and	presented	system	update	status	to	management.	 ■ Implemented	DLP	via	ePO,	from	test	phase	to	full	production	rollout.	 ■ Configured	and	managed	mail/word-based	rules	and	security	policies,	including	modifications.	 ■ Executed	full	disk	encryption	for	laptops	and	desktops	through	ePO.	 ■ Led	ePO	migration	(5.0	to	5.3.0)	and	coordinated	with	vendors	on	Azure	Site	Recovery	(ASR)	for	DR.	 ■ Managed	centralized	patching,	antivirus	updates,	and	remote	workstation	security.	 ■ ■ Handled	ITIL-based	incident	management	via	SM7	ticketing	tool.	 ■ Delivered	24×7	support	for	two	critical	security	projects.

Provided	security	support,	incident	resolution,	and	requirements	analysis.

EUC	engineer	and	Windows	Administrator

■ ■ Managed	VMware	vCenter	5.x,	including	VM	provisioning,	cloning,	and	template	management.	 ■ Oversaw	AD	identity	management,	DirSync	to	Office	365,	license	assignments,	and	access	control.	 ■ Installed,	configured,	and	troubleshot	operating	systems,	desktops,	laptops,	and	applications.	 ■ Provided	application	support	for	Finacle	and	managed	software	installation/troubleshooting.

Administered	Windows	Server	2008	R2/2012/2012R2	across	physical,	blade,	and	virtual	environments.

■ ■ Utilized	HP	Service	Manager	7	&	9	for	incident	and	request	management.	 ■

Configured	and	supported	MS	Outlook	(20xx),	McAfee	AV,	and	encryption	tools.

Coordinated	with	vendors	and	handled	escalations	to	maintain	service	continuity.

SCHOLASTIC	CREDENTIALS

■ MTech	(System	Engineering)	BITS	PILANI	 ■ BTech	(Information	Systems)	BITS	PILANI	 ■ DIPLOMA	(Electronic)	NTTF	Bangalore

CERTIFICATIONS	and	TRAINING
